notes: Census measured 61 distinct final URLs × 2 widths (360, 1440); the 9 captured source URLs that redirect resolve to measured targets, so all 70 records have computed-style coverage.

Palette capped at 8. Dropped (low weight / third-party / plugin chrome): #000000 (slider bullet + search button borders), #d9dcdf and #10181f and #70787f (ICS calendar), #00000033 (back-to-top), #cccccc80 (testimonial avatar border), #ffffff40 (top-bar tint), #ddb36e80 and #ddb93380 (per-page header tint variants), #e09500 and #f2ab41 (slider caption text).
Radius: home-only mode would read 50% (slider bullets); cross-page mode is 200px (60px circular icon chips, 688 occurrences). Neither is a container radius — content is square-cornered.
No <h1> on any captured page (WordPress page titles switched off); the largest visible heading is h2 50px/200.
Logo == favicon: the same 172×136 PNG badge serves as site icon. A 75px JPG variant is used in the mobile header.
Home intro links point at legacy /wp/... paths (e.g. /wp/the-house/); experiences pages embed images from /wp/wp-content/... — link/asset debt to resolve in migration.
COVID-19 page renders a raw [ultimate_heading …] shortcode as text (deactivated plugin) — source defect.
Reservations pages render an Airbnb iCal feed whose DOM exposes reservation URLs and guest phone last-4 digits — privacy concern for migration.
